headline: Dangote Refinery Targets December 1 for Historic NGX Listing
summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals is scheduled to list on the Nigerian Exchange Limited, marking a major milestone for local capital markets.
why: Major equity listings expand local stock exchange capitalization and provide investment opportunities in domestic downstream energy infrastructure.

impacts.name: Nigerian Exchange
impacts.why: Listing a massive industrial asset expands market capitalization and liquidity on the exchange.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
